Synthetic permission-group union capture, 2026-11-09, on a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub. At source API 62.0 and 67.0 an @IsTest method constructs two permission sets: the first grants API Enabled; the second grants API Enabled and Run Reports. It adds the first, adds the second, removes the first, then removes the second, calculating the group after each change and querying its associated PermissionSet. The assertion payload in org.tsv shows both captured fields after each step. Scratch deletion succeeded and the unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
